CustomObject.description: Roster/config for the PCR v2 sector approval engine. One record per sector x round (9 R1 + 4 R2). Drives PCRSectorGenerator (which children to create), the notify/gate flows (which Public Group to route to), and PCRSectorGate/PCRSectorDecision (which fields a sector owns and must fill before Approved).
